title: Concept: Locked dependency with an empty content hash
description: packages.lock.json declares a `contentHash` field that is present but empty, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `contentHash` field that is present but empty.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.lock.json (nuget).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `contentHash` field that is present but empty.
